caption: Winston Churchill (1874–1965), First Lord of the Admiralty 1911–1915 — sent the Royal Naval Division to Antwerp in October 1914 and went there himself; a cross-era figure who reappears at Gallipoli, in the interwar years and in 1940. Colorized (AI-assisted) from a public-domain photograph.
credit: Original photograph: agency stringer, 16 Sept 1914; public domain (via Wikimedia Commons). Colorization: Sandtable, AI-assisted, 2026.
